item.title: Generating Resolved Kinematics and Mass Distribution from Multi-Band Imaging
item.description: This work proposes a generative modeling approach to infer resolved kinematic and mass-distribution information directly from multi-band imaging data.

item.title: From Halos to Galaxies XII: Halo Mass as the Stronger Correlate of Central-Galaxy Quenching with Halo-Mass Estimates Consistent with Weak-Lensing Constraints
item.description:
Abstract

This work reassesses the relative roles of halo mass and central-region properties in central-galaxy quenching using halo-mass estimates whose stellar-to-halo mass relations are consistent with independent weak-lensing measurements. With these estimates, halo mass becomes the stronger correlate of quenching, whereas conventional abundance-matching halo masses recover the previously reported stronger dependence on central velocity dispersion.

Publication Details

  • Authors: Dingyi Zhao, Yingjie Peng
  • Venue: The Astrophysical Journal (submitted).
  • Status: manuscript submitted; twelfth paper in the From Halos to Galaxies series.

item.title: No Detectable One-halo Galactic Conformity Signal with Halo-mass Estimates Consistent with Weak-lensing Constraints
item.description:
Abstract

Using three halo-mass estimates for SDSS galaxy groups, this Letter shows that the strong one-halo galactic conformity signal obtained with conventional abundance-matching halo masses is not reproduced with machine-learning halo masses consistent with independent weak-lensing constraints, suggesting that the earlier signal was largely driven by halo-mass estimation biases.

Publication Details

  • Authors: Dingyi Zhao, Yingjie Peng, et al.
  • Venue: The Astrophysical Journal Letters, 1009, L7 (2026).
  • Status: published; seventeenth paper in the From Halos to Galaxies series.

item.title: From Halos to Galaxies VI: Improved Halo Mass Estimation for SDSS Groups
item.description: This paper presents an improved framework for halo mass estimation in SDSS galaxy groups and provides updated constraints on the halo mass function.
